status: Separate optional-use cohorts, not D1 and not pooled with each other. Agents could use an index but were not required to. Sanitized counts only; pending independent scientific and privacy review before publication.

definitions.indexed_sessions: Sessions in which a native Graphify or sql_orient index was available to the agent.
definitions.sessions_with_any_index_operation: Indexed sessions in which the agent made at least one index tool call or SQL execution.
